Definition: Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Zoar = "insignificance"; 1) a city at the southeast end of the Dead Sea grouped with Sodom and Gomorrah as being one of the 5 cities slated for destruction by God; spared at Lot's plea as his place of refuge
